job_statement: When running a large number of concurrent pipeline tasks, I want to understand the performance characteristics and limitations, so I can plan capacity and set realistic expectations for pipeline execution.
desired_outcomes: Reduce planning time for capacity requirements
notes: Core planning job. Document provides reference performance data from Red Hat testing: 60 concurrent pipelines on m6a.2xlarge AWS nodes.

job_statement: When experiencing slowness or recurrent failures of pipeline runs, I want to improve pipeline performance through infrastructure and configuration changes, so I can ensure reliable and timely pipeline execution.
notes: Main optimization job covering infrastructure scaling and high-availability configuration.

section: Improving OpenShift Pipelines performance - Monitor node resources
job_statement: As a Platform Administrator, when pipeline performance degrades, I want to monitor node resource usage to identify capacity constraints, so I can determine if infrastructure scaling is needed.
parent_job: Improve pipeline performance through infrastructure and configuration changes
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to identify resource bottlenecks
notes: Monitoring approach for detecting resource constraints. Part of optimization workflow.

section: Improving OpenShift Pipelines performance - Scale cluster nodes
job_statement: As a Platform Administrator, when resource usage is high and pipeline performance degrades, I want to increase the number of cluster nodes, so I can provide adequate resources for concurrent pipeline execution.
parent_job: Improve pipeline performance through infrastructure and configuration changes
desired_outcomes: Ensure sufficient capacity for concurrent pipelines
notes: Infrastructure scaling approach. Prerequisite to high-availability configuration.

section: Improving OpenShift Pipelines performance - Enable high-availability mode
job_statement: As a Platform Administrator, when pipeline execution times are high and pod creation is delayed, I want to enable high-availability mode for the Tekton controller, so I can reduce latency and improve concurrent pipeline execution.
parent_job: Improve pipeline performance through infrastructure and configuration changes
desired_outcomes: Minimize TaskRun to pod start delay
notes: High-availability configuration approach. Red Hat testing showed significant improvement in pipeline execution times and pod creation latency. Requires setting disable-ha=false, buckets=5-10, replicas>2 and <=buckets.

section: Improving OpenShift Pipelines performance - Tune HA parameters
job_statement: As a Performance Engineer, when high-availability mode is enabled, I want to tune the buckets and replicas parameters, so I can optimize controller performance for my specific workload without exhausting node resources.
parent_job: Improve pipeline performance through infrastructure and configuration changes
notes: Performance tuning approach. Document recommends buckets=5-10, replicas>2 and <=buckets. Higher numbers generally beneficial but require monitoring for resource exhaustion.
